actors.name: Driver
actors.description: Sets speed and following-gap, overrides via brake or accelerator

actors.name: Lead Vehicle
actors.description: Preceding vehicle whose range and range-rate ACC tracks

interfaces.description: Set-speed, gap setting, resume/cancel via steering-wheel switches
Status and take-over request via cluster

use_cases.name: Engage ACC
use_cases.description: Driver activates ACC above minimum speed

use_cases.name: Driver override
use_cases.description: Brake pedal cancels, accelerator temporarily overrides

use_cases.name: Hand back control
use_cases.description: ACC requests take-over on capability limit

scenarios.name: Lead vehicle cut-in
scenarios.description: Vehicle enters gap; ACC decelerates to restore time-gap

scenarios.name: Heavy rain, radar degraded
scenarios.description: Sensor blockage; ACC hands back control

stakeholder_needs.need: Reduce workload on long highway drives
Never exceed 3.5 m/s2 deceleration in ACC
Clear indication when ACC is inactive
